items.title: Mike Davis interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 1, 2024
items.q: people like Steve Turré, Robin Eubanks, Conrad Herwig, Birch Johnson, Jim Pugh played on that

ctx.x: Do you feel driven to help in any way you can to keep the trombone alive?

For sure. That’s why this was years — actually this is our 30 anniversary of Hip-Bone Music when I started. And the first record that I did was with the 16 different trombone players from New York, although Watrous was in town so we got him to play on two of the tracks. He was the only guy that wasn’t a New York-based person. But people like Steve Turré, Robin Eubanks, Conrad Herwig, Birch Johnson, Jim Pugh played on that, Dave Taylor. And a lot of that was, yeah, for what you’re just describing Monk, like trying…
I’m happy to hear you say that because some people take the other attitude that the music business is in the pits and so forth, and I’m glad to hear you optimistic about it.
